record.paper_title: FPT Suspects and Tough Customers: Open Problems of Downey and Fellows
record.context_brief: Kernelization for directed feedback vertex set
record.original_question: Does Directed Feedback Vertex Set admit a polynomial kernel when parameterized by the size k of the feedback vertex set?

evidence.quote: The existence of polynomial kernel is also open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
In the Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem one is given a directed graph $D=(V,E)$ together with a positive integer $k$, and the task is to decide whether there exists a set $S\subseteq V$ with $|S|\le k$ such that the digraph $D-S$ contains no directed cycle (such a set $S$ is called a directed feedback vertex set of $D$). The problem is known to be fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by $k$.

A polynomial kernel for a parameterized problem is a polynomial-time algorithm that, given an instance $(D,k)$, produces an equivalent instance $(D',k')$ of the same problem such that $|V(D')|+|E(D')|+k'$ is bounded by a polynomial in $k$.

Question: Does the Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem, parameterized by the size $k$ of the feedback vertex set, admit a polynomial kernel?
artifact.status_search_result: As of recent literature (including works from 2020–2025), the existence of a polynomial kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set parameterized by solution size $k$ remains one of the central open problems in kernelization. Partial progress has been made: polynomial kernels are known for restricted classes (e.g., tournaments, "wannabe bounded treewidth" graphs) and for alternative parameterizations (e.g., undirected feedback vertex number), but the general question is still unresolved—indeed, it is open even on planar digraphs.

status_evidence.title: Towards a Polynomial Kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set
status_evidence.snippet: The existence of a polynomial kernel for DFVS, parameterized by the solution size k, is a central open problem in kernelization.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is recognized as a central open problem in kernelization.

status_evidence.title: Wannabe Bounded Treewidth Graphs Admit a Polynomial Kernel for Directed Feedback Vertex Set
status_evidence.snippet: Polynomial kernels for DFVS are known on restricted classes; the existence of a polynomial kernel for DFVS is open even when the input digraph is planar.
status_evidence.claim: Only restricted-case polynomial kernels are known; the general problem and even the planar case remain open.
